Each topic, secretly roll the centurion's Listen 50 for all of them; two successes and he notices the ships: "When the farthest ship began to rock, the centurion came back from his dream of wine and grease to the cold. He gripped his weapon and stared at you in disbelief; the others came awake too, though the drink made their hands shake."

  • Combat. If the party poisoned the food, every soldier dies one round later.
  • Soldiers: HP 10, STR 60, DEX 50, Blade 40, no armour, DB 0.
  • Any soldier but the centurion below half HP leaves the fight to raise the alarm. Distance starts at 0; at 2 he is away. Each round he rolls DEX to gain 1; a PC needs a combined DEX + fighting skill to stop and strike him; bows need no DEX roll.
  • One escapes = alarm: Ashu sends men at once; Duan, as commander of the vanguard, is executed under military law; every fisherman in the raid dies when the relief arrives. None escapes: Duan has time to leave; fishermen's losses by a GM 1D100.
The Han is blacker still at night under the low cloud, a pool of black water deep enough to eat a man. It has: Song flesh and Mongol flesh, men's blood and women's, the bones of wanderers, travellers, fishermen and generals crunched and swallowed. And now these monsters that boasted of conquering seas will sleep on its bank and never again grind a single inch of ground for their great lord.

Afterwards the assassination is still possible: Ashu's wound worsens and he seeks a cure more desperately.

West dock: the Pavilion of the Untied Pendant 西码头 · 解佩亭

On the north bank, named for Zheng Jiaofu and the goddess; once a place for viewing the river, now ruined, reeking. Rotting corpses and the stone lie under the debris; STR to shift it. HO3 finds a token of Captain Liu's here, suggesting his death. The bodies: swollen, discoloured, unrecognisable, marks of violent impact, wounds a pulp: SAN 1/1D3; Spot Hidden: prison clothes, tattooed faces. The stone: strange, twisting and rounded, full of holes; Idea / EDU: a Grand Lake Stone, the Daoist "cave-heaven"; Spot Hidden on the base: the seal "七宝行 Seven Treasures".

"The goddess comes in dreams" (night, anywhere on the bank) 神女入梦来

Fog and dim moon; someone wades into the river and stops only when the water is at their shoulders. Not stopped: next moment a spine pierces the chest. The rite takes two rounds — one to pierce, one to inject; pulled out between them the victim dies on the spot. After two rounds the spine detaches from whatever it joins below and leaves a lump on the body; the victim walks away. Stop them now and they are already dead but not yet turned: no response, and any damage kills. Stopped (DEX): they wake as from a dream — they were asleep at home a moment ago; they have been meeting the Lady of the Han in dreams night after night.

The reeds: forcing the crossing 芦苇荡 · 三惑迷津

If the party tries to cross without dealing with Gla'aki: three PCs and one boatman only. Gla'aki prefers dreams to fighting. Each failed temptation is answered with reality: they wake in the freezing Han, the boat capsized, the boatman gone, spines circling — swim and fight for one round before the next dream takes them. Three dreams (read-aloud texts in the handouts page "The three temptations"):

  • 1 · The River Lord's dream 河伯入梦: beyond the fog, calm open water; a giant turtle surfaces bearing a white-haired immortal fishing with a straight hook, three stools, a tea table, a bucket of small fish. "I am He Bo 冯夷, fishing for all the world. I waited five hundred years for the first fish, three hundred for the second…" A fish in the bucket swells to the size of a warship and swims off. "Mortal cares are heavy; stay and fish with me? One of these fish is a hundred years; one would feed both banks!" Accept = all become Undying Servants, everyone LOST. Refuse and the dream breaks, then the next begins.
  • 2 · The goddess unties her pendant 神女解佩: a goddess in bright robes walks on the fog and tells her story — a maid given to King Zhao of Zhou, drowned with him when the Chu sank the boat, "and do you know what lies on the bed of the Han? Ghosts and dragons waiting to gnaw my flesh. That is the price of loyalty." She seizes a random PC and shows a hideous twisted face: SAN 1/1D3; then, composed again, invites them: the Song is finished, how long will the Mongols last? Drift with her. Accept = LOST. Refuse and she gives the seized PC a jade pendant: its holder is not attacked by Gla'aki this round.
  • 3 · The Many-Headed Fish 何罗鱼: a fish with one head and ten bodies rises, crying like a bird, the ten bodies swimming ten ways and shaking the whole river. POW: fail and you believe you are a fish and leap in; others may STR to hold you while feeling the same pull. Twice. Whoever still knows they are human finds the weapon in their hand and the fish before them. The dream ends when they attack: they are washed up on the Southbright shore.

→ Ending 2.

The Watchtower: the last night 塔楼 · 决战

The night of the lockdown, or the night the party chooses to end it. Show the players the rules card "The Watchtower". The tower is about fifteen zhang (50 m), all timber; climbing it is CON. Two soldiers below and one above. If Magistrate Fan was executed his head hangs from the tower: SAN 0/1.

Preparation 准备阶段

  • HO1 meets the boatman alone in the reeds. Unless the party neither killed Ashu nor sank the ships, Duan is there chatting with the boatman: he wants to be bait with HO1, for friendship, not gain. If HO1 never won the monk's golden kasaya, Duan can hand it over (drop this to raise difficulty). HO1 may leave him on the bank. Duan: "Could you really leave a helpless civilian like me in this den of wolves? Take me with you, hero — I cannot close my eyes at night in this town. If you succeed I cross with you; if you fail I have no foothold here either. Let us gamble together."
  • HO2: Doctor Yue, if alive, walks HO2 to the foot of the tower and confesses: "I was at the river the day Fencewall surrendered. I should not have gone. If I had not come to spy on the bank pretending to be a messenger, if the men preparing the rite had not seen me, if they had not started early… General Liu and his men would have crossed safely."
  • HO3: on the tower, close enough to touch the sky, Liu talks to ease the nerves: what HO3 will do afterwards; what he himself now is.

The fight 战斗

HO1 on the water: through the fog, two spine attacks before mid-river (the boatman dodges automatically). Then in the boat's light HO1 and the boatman see Gla'aki: SAN 1D3/1D20; HO1 does not go mad (for the story's sake).

As on the night you first tried to leave, a leaf of a boat slides out over the heaving Han. The fog swallows everything; under the water, a muffled roaring. Thin quick shadows flick beneath the surface and in a blink break it, driving at the boat. The boatman leans on his pole, the hull swings, and two spines miss. Then something vast rises slowly under the water: an oval, slug-like body bristling with metallic spines that throw back colours like oil on water; one end foul as a catfish, porous and unclean; three eye-stalks growing from its head with huge eyeballs at their ends; under its belly hundreds of pale short feet, working. And beside your boat one spine waits.
  • One spine in the river each round, DEX order. HO1 in the boat: the spine attacks the boat (boatman rolls Boat; boat HP 20, sunk at 0). HO1 in the air (Fire-Cloak): 1D2 for the target. Cutting off a spine: Gla'aki cannot attack with one next round, and loses 8 HP per spine.
  • Each round HO1 either signals (fire; gunpowder needs Luck in the wet fog; the Fire-Cloak makes HO1 the beacon) or attacks the spine.
  • HO2 at the tower's foot: each round 1D3+2 Undying come, in monster form (SAN 1/1D8 first sight, 1/1D4 if seen before). HO2 acts first: DEX — fail / success / Extreme / critical = 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 actions; each action an Acupoint Strike (+10% with the needles) that kills one Undying outright. Other wanderers can hold Servants but not kill them (they do not know the spot, or cannot hit it); blocked and unkilled Servants carry to the next round; unblocked ones attack HO2.
  • HO3 on the tower: may shoot only in a round HO1 signals: Bow at Gla'aki; the fire shows only a rough position, so Liu Spot Hidden for the water — success gives HO3 a bonus die. HO3 is nearest the Dream-Call: POW every three rounds, fail = temporary insanity.

Gla'aki: give it about 40–60 HP for the table (each severed spine −8; each God-Arm arrow 1D8+2 with a Hard success doubling). It is a long way off: without the bow nothing on the bank reaches it. Spine: HP 10 (shared with the body), DEX 50, attack 40, 2+1D5, armour 4; fire ignores the armour.

At 0 HP: from the boat HO1 watches the fluids drain from the body and the husk crumble to dust; HO3 feels the calling that has been in his head for a week stop; every Servant at HO2's feet turns and leaves. The fog lifts from the river, and across the water Southbright stands clear.

pages.name: 可选与个人 Optional & personal events

text.content:
Optional and personal events 可选事件 · 个人事件

Chance encounters (any street, any day) 可选事件

  • An old friend of medicine 岐黄旧识: the first meeting with Doctor Yue, anywhere on Front/Back Street or the Crossing except the Theatre and Temple. He checks HO2 first (pulse, tongue, breath: "white coat, floating tight pulse, wind in the body — drink hot water"), then reads the others' faces ("full brow but dark between the eyes — a hard road"; "noble bearing hiding decline — a pearl in dust"). While talking he picks one small item from a PC other than HO2: secret opposed Sleight of Hand 75 vs Spot Hidden; success, the item is gone; failure, he apologises frankly ("checking who you are, for HO2's sake"). Either way he gives it to HO2 that night to return.
  • A stumbling horse 当道踬马: Duan rides by with four or five men. If Yue is present he passes and dusts Duan's horse: it drops, vomiting and convulsing, and Duan goes over its head. Watch, or help: Medicine sees poison, Spot Hidden the powder in the mane; helping earns a favour; the bold can lift a token from Duan or his men — found out, he lets it go for HO1's sake.
  • A chance meeting over books 素书偶逢: Magistrate Fan at the book stall or the Library; learned, happy to discuss, dropping hints; on the war he is iron-hard and unyielding — the opposite of the man who opened the gates. He pretends not to know HO3; named, he glosses over it.
  • The dead speak 尸假人言: at night an Undying poses as someone asking help or directions and strikes; unwary targets give it a bonus die. Use anywhere at night to block, harden or tighten.
  • Riding you down 当途据鞍: Toghan, going to or from Wang Wu's, recognises HO2 and rides straight at her, insulting her and her father in broken Chinese, describing his death. DEX or 1D3 under the hooves. Pick his or his men's pockets (tokens, the banquet note). If the party swallows it he leaves for his camp rounds; at drawn steel Duan may intervene; Toghan despises him but gives way.

HO1: the empty tomb 先人衣冠

Asked about the Hermit's effects, Duan says he raised a cenotaph for him on the riverbank; the body Ashu threw to the dogs, the effects Duan gathered quietly and kept untouched. He will take HO1 alone, that night, with a jug of good wine. A stone with the name and dates, a few incense sticks and cold ash; a few steps off, the Han rolls east. Duan pours cold wine, then takes a wooden box from behind the stone: a leather scabbard and a few ancient pages protected between silk gauze with starch paste, the writing almost gone. Hard Spot Hidden / Library Use (or a whole round) reads a spell for walking on clouds wrapped in starfire — Red Pine's going and coming as he pleased. Learning it needs an Idea roll.

Fire-Cloak 火焰斗篷术 (Grand Grimoire p. 66): 12 MP, 1D6 SAN, 1 round to cast, lasts 4D4 rounds. Wrapped in white-hot light: flight; a bonus die to Dodge, DEX and melee; melee hits add a stacking burn, 1D3 per stack per round. Cost: 1D3 damage to the caster each round until 0 HP, and 1D6 extra SAN for the agony; all attacks on the caster take a penalty die; bare-handed attackers take 1D6 per hit. Seeing it: SAN 1/1D3. The Hermit never believed the legend and never read the pages.

Duan keeps urging HO1 to work with the Mongols to kill the river monster: his awkward position in the army, then a promise of safety for all the party; the answer changes nothing afterwards: "If it were only the crossing, for old times' sake of course I would help. But the thing in the river threatens my army too — in a few days I lead the vanguard against Southbright, and one slip is a court-martial. Let us finish the monster together. You think stopping the army stops the Marshal? Without killing the monster, crossing means speed and luck, nine deaths in ten. You would dare it; I cannot rest easy." Let the players see it: killing Gla'aki also lets the Mongols cross — the Fan uncle and nephew knew that.

HO3: the dreams and the Rashomon alley 梦引 · 罗生门巷

Night of the 11th: a familiar voice calls HO3's name in sleep; POW, fail: waves, snapping timbers, screams, SAN 1/1D3. Night of the 12th: the second Dream-Call draws HO3 alone to the bank with a false light (full text in the Session 0 runbook, Extended Day One): the dream of the boat breaking and a spine through the chest, SAN 1/1D3; POW, fail and HO3 is waist-deep following a light; the spine strikes from behind (Dodge, or 1D3); Liu appears, throws a rusty sword, fights the spine (HP 10, DEX 50, 40, 2+1D5) and joins for good.

The Rashomon alley 罗生门巷: the Undying are ordered to kill the one who took the gift and escaped — Liu. Chen 陈寻忠 arranges to meet Liu at night at the Street Crossing; if not invited along, Liu goes alone and reports afterwards. With HO3 present: a dark, cold, empty crossing. Chen reminisces and tells half-truths: the Fan uncle and nephew caused the horrors and have locked their drowned comrades in the temple's back hall — bait to draw Liu there for a mob attack. "My lord, you are thinner than in Lin'an. You were the emperor's favourite then; to see you brought to this breaks my heart." "That storm mid-river was no act of heaven but the Fans' sorcery. The water looked calm — even young General Liu was fooled — but the centre was bottomless and bubbleless, so I knew. The boatmen were their men. At mid-river fog and rain and a green light in the clouds, and the boats went over in an instant. I clung to a gunwale; our brothers sank like posts. At dawn I washed ashore and saw cage carts take our comrades into the temple's back hall. The Fans have called on some evil god — this Chu country loves human sacrifice; our men will feed the shamans!" Liu is furious and ashamed; Chen proposes rescuing the soldiers tomorrow night (uses the night). If HO3 wants the others along, Chen demurs (Psychology sees another purpose): "the jianghu is full of schemers; what if they tell the Mongols?" He glances towards Back Street and hurries off; a watchman boy comes by — Nameless Fang, if met, recognises Chen as the thief he chased into the restaurant, whose owner would not believe him and made him pay for the broken tables.

Endings 结局

1 · "Rise and fall are the work of men; the mountains and rivers are only a shape" 兴废由人事，山川空地形

Stopped the crossing, dispelled Gla'aki, crossed. If Ashu is dead: Kublai has lost his right arm and the army its invincible general; a great man dead at a nobody's hand, as in a hundred histories — honour, or arrogance? Cold water on the fire of conquest: smoke everywhere, the fire not out. If the ships are sunk: horsemen who would walk on water need something to carry them; the ships lie on the bottom with their enemies, and it will take years, and the bones of more slaves and prisoners, to build again. Either way the Song court is not yet on fire: the people can pay a few more years of taxes, the ministers hear a few more years of songs, the city commanders send a few more letters asking for relief that never comes. The Han is quiet; the faithful servants who walked the night are gone. The goddess of the Han was a legend; perhaps once she was real, but the age of the sage-kings is long over — if goddesses could save dynasties, why did Xia fall to Shang and Han to Tang? Southbright rejoices. Its commander Lü Wenhuan 吕文焕 sends up a memorial for your honours and plans a stele on the bank for the fallen. HO1 and the Hermit go into the town's storytellers' best tale; HO2's pharmacy is famous — "its medicine raises the dead and kills without a trace"; HO3 and Liu are pardoned for the failed relief. Ten thousand miles of road ahead, and nothing left in the world that can stop you like the Han did.

2 · "The old owl becomes a tree-spirit; laughter and green fire rise from the nest" 百年老鸮成木魅，笑声碧火巢中起

Gla'aki not dispelled; the party crossed (by the reeds, or otherwise). Whatever the party did, the Mongols cannot cross while it lives. They never guess what lies under the Han; some smell danger and most pretend not to. The goddess's majesty means nothing to men who fear no Chinese god and have always taken victory with their hands; so she accepts the feast, and the living and the dead become her strength. She puts no rope on the people and makes no slaves, but she is a far worse enemy than the invaders. Across the water Southbright lives through something more dangerous than a siege: Lü Wenhuan does not even know where the enemy is. Every night townsfolk walk into the Han and are taken, and come back next day unharmed; the legend of the goddess rises again and almost everyone prays to her to carry the Song through. Apart from Fan in his grave, you alone know. Tell Lü Wenhuan? Another scholar-official — who says he would not think as the Fans did? Or keep silent and leave Southbright by night. It does not matter: south of the Central Plains the Song is still bright and beautiful.

3 · "Human affairs change; coming and going make the past and present" 人事有代谢，往来成古今

Gla'aki dispelled, crossing not stopped; the party crossed. Everything returns to its track; the fog might never have been. When the Mongol banners fly over the Han, all the rise and fall that follows is natural. Lü Wenhuan hears of Fan's death and surrenders in three days, opening the broad road into the heartland. Within three years the Mongols are at Lin'an; the emperor and the empress dowager surrender; the Southern Song is gone. You are not surprised: what wound of the Central Plains did not tell you the Song was doomed? For the people, rise and fall are both misery; for the great, a new set of winners at the table; for you, the road that had to be chosen.

Personal endings 个人结局

  • HO1 may wander on; with his skill he could serve anyone, even Kublai. Duan has no wish to hold office again, and his credit is nearly spent; if allowed, he follows HO1.
  • HO2's house is famous; inherit and build it, or scatter the fortune on the resistance — HO2 decides how. Doctor Yue goes on robbing the rich for the poor, and gladly minds the pharmacy's affairs for HO2.
  • HO3, without a deed to show in Fencewall, may face charges in Lin'an, though the family can probably bury it; a rich idler, or an official trying to save the broken machine. Liu goes on fighting at the front; whatever HO3 chooses, Liu is HO3's truest friend.

目标：介绍三位角色、跑完三段个人导入和公共导入“夜渡汉水”，在公布樊城地图前停下。约2.5–3小时。

流程 · Agenda

  • 15分钟：玩家入门（见《玩家入门》日志），电视上放「汉江两岸」地图（0c）。

导入前的注意 · Before you start

    Read the finale (Watchtower, pp. 41–42 of the original): Niu's God-Arm Bow, the Ling needles and a fire signal are prerequisites. Keep them in mind from day one.
  • 作者提示：玩家可能觉得压力大，鼓励他们大胆行事。
    Author's note: players may feel the pressure; encourage them to act boldly.
  • 导入只是正式开始前的一段；与关联NPC（段游衍、越南柯、刘卿堂）的相处可酌情加戏。

个人导入 HO1：庆功宴刺杀（场景：樊城衙署·庆功宴） · Personal intro HO1: the banquet (scene: The Victory Banquet)

咸淳三年末，樊城三日即降。山阳道人不眠不休三日，于清晨将成名剑“止水”赠予你，要你效仿荆轲、聂政刺杀兀良哈·阿术。

Fencewall fell in three days. The Hermit did not sleep for three nights, then at dawn gave you Stillwater and told you to kill Marshal Ashu as the assassins of old killed tyrants.

赠剑（读给玩家）：第四天清晨，师父把一柄三尺长剑横放在你面前。剑鞘旧得发白，剑身却亮得照得见人，靠近剑锷处有一道墨痕，像一片没擦干的水迹。他说：这剑叫止水。

The sword (read aloud): On the fourth morning your master lays a sword across the table in front of you. The sheath is worn pale; the blade is bright enough to show your face, and near the guard there is a dark stain, like water that never dried. "Her name is Stillwater," he says.

“你师父我老啦，怕是走不进那蒙古鞑子十步。你虽年纪轻轻，但足有乱军之中取敌方首级的本事。不为那大宋稀里糊涂的官家，为的是汉水边的百姓！若是能取兀良哈这厮项上人头，今年清明就把他的首级跟着一壶梅子酒一壶枇杷酒两斤牛肉一个猪头两只烧鸡三个烧饼一起供给我；若是不能，你便自在逍遥闯荡江湖去，去哪都成，等到这中原安定了再回来！”

"Your master is old. I could not get within ten paces of that Mongol. You are young, and you can take a head out of the middle of an army. Not for that muddle-headed emperor; for the people on the banks of the Han! If you take Ashu's head, lay it on my grave-table this Tomb-Sweeping Day with a jug of plum wine, a jug of loquat wine, two catties of beef, a pig's head, two roast chickens and three sesame cakes. If you cannot, go and wander the jianghu, anywhere you like, and come home when the Central Plains are at peace."

“剑上这道黑，是雨师墨。江湖上传是赤松子留下的仙术，其实是荆湖一带的毒。刀饮即腐：沾了它的伤口烂而不死，逢阴雨便发，一辈子好不了。所以不可轻率出剑；这东西沾了谁，谁便一辈子记得你。你自己的刀照旧用，止水只为一个人出鞘。”

"That black on the blade is Rainmaster's Ink. In the jianghu they say it is Red Pine's immortal art; it is only a poison from these river marshes. What it cuts, rots: the wound will not kill, and it will not heal, and every rainy day it opens again for the rest of a man's life. So do not draw her lightly. Whoever she touches will remember you until they die. Keep using your own blade; Stillwater leaves the sheath for one man only."

（师父把这话叮嘱了三遍。之后不必再解释；玩家自会在阿术伤口不愈时想起。）

(He says this three times. Don't explain further; the player will remember it when Ashu's wound refuses to heal.)

（段游衍已写信向山阳道人保证会保护HO1；若HO1追问，师父只会含糊其辞。）

(Duan Driftwood has written to the Hermit promising to protect HO1. If HO1 presses, the master is evasive.)

进城：城门有兵检查，混入需乔装/幸运；翻墙需攀爬/跳跃。阿术不许士兵劫掠，城中除遍地巡逻兵外百姓照常生活。

Getting in: the gates are checked. Disguise or Luck to slip through; Climb or Jump to go over the wall. Ashu forbids looting, so the town is calm apart from patrols everywhere.

今晚是犒赏三军的庆功宴，鸡鸭牛羊和美酒一车车运进衙署。宴会厅由宋官操办，却处处迎合蒙古口味：烤肉代替精致菜肴，酒盏换成手掌大的瓷碗，宋女歌舞，蒙古人看直了眼。

Tonight is the victory feast; carts of poultry, beef, mutton and wine roll into the Magistracy. The hall was laid out by Song officials to Mongol taste: roast meat instead of delicacies, palm-sized bowls instead of wine cups, Song dancers the Mongols cannot stop staring at.

阿术坐上首：身高八尺，体格健壮，皮肤粗糙，留胡须，戴毡帽，穿软甲，手边一把厚重马刀。段游衍坐在他右手下一位。范玉楼、许德显等宋官在座，范玉楼的吹捧尤其夸张。

Ashu sits on the dais: well over six feet, heavy-built, weathered skin, bearded, in a felt hat and soft armour, a huge sabre at his hand. Duan Driftwood sits one seat down on his right. Song officials are present, Magistrate Fan and Prefect Xu among them; Fan's flattery is embarrassing.

出剑：▶ 播放音效「战 Battle」（循环）。HO1趁阿术不备拔剑，他避过要害，剑刃落在惯用手肩膀。阿术踢开案几，抄起马刀劈来：闪避成功则躲开，否则受1D4伤害，伤口深可见骨，生命值上限-1。

The strike: ▶ Start the 战 Battle sound effect (loops). Ashu twists so the blade takes his sword-arm shoulder instead of his throat, kicks the table over and swings the sabre. Dodge to avoid it; otherwise 1D4 damage, a wound to the bone, and max HP -1.

止水上的雨师墨使阿术的伤口无法愈合：整个模组中他的所有检定都带一个惩罚骰。

The Rainmaster's Ink on Stillwater means Ashu's wound will not heal: every roll he makes for the rest of the scenario carries a penalty die.

护卫围上，弓弦绞紧。HO1可与士兵搏斗或继续攻击阿术。一轮后段游衍挡在两人之间，表面护主，实则搅乱场面：

Guards close in, bows drawn. HO1 may fight the soldiers or keep going for Ashu. After one round Duan steps between them, apparently to shield the marshal, actually to make chaos:

“谁敢放箭？！大帅还在这里呢！！大帅，您先走！！有末将在，这刺客定然没办法伤到您一根汗毛！！天啊，大帅竟然受伤了？！还不快护着大帅撤退！！你们还愣着干什么！！”

"Who dares shoot? The Marshal is right here! Marshal, go, go! While I stand here this assassin will not touch a hair of yours! Heaven, the Marshal is wounded! Get him out, get him out! What are you all standing there for?!"

阿术要他让开，他也生生挡着。HO1趁乱脱身，藏入樊城（▶ 停止「战 Battle」）。之后：被抓只是时间问题，浮桥已断，江岸有兵；但只要钱到位，总有人铤而走险。晚间你带着全副身家来到江岸芦苇丛，其他想过河的人也在那里。→ 公共导入。

Even when Ashu tells him to move he stays put. HO1 slips away and goes to ground (▶ stop 战 Battle). Afterwards: it is only a matter of time before they find you. The bridge is cut and the bank is guarded, but money finds a boatman. That night you bring everything you own to the reeds on the bank, where other would-be passengers are waiting. → Night Crossing.

个人导入 HO2：截杀与入城（场景：樊城·北门） · Personal intro HO2: the convoy and the gate (scene: Fencewall, the North Gate)

时间与形势：咸淳三年腊月末（1267年12月），比庆功宴早两周。樊城尚未陷落：元军已占据城外四野，城头仍是宋军旗帜，北门戒严。药行奉朝廷调令押送一批药材作军资，父亲亲自随行；车队沿官道北上，在樊城北门外的大路上被一支蒙古军队拦下，为首的是将军兀良哈·脱欢，汉话不利索，身后的汉人将军段游衍只好交涉。两人不太对付。

When and where: the end of December 1267, two weeks before the banquet. Fencewall has not fallen yet: the Mongol army holds the country around it, Song banners still fly on the battlements, and the North Gate is under martial law. The pharmacy is under court orders to deliver a convoy of medicine as army supplies; your father leads it himself. On the road outside the North Gate the convoy is stopped by a Mongol detachment under General Toghan 脱欢. He barely speaks Chinese; the Chinese general beside him, Duan Driftwood 段游衍, does the talking. The two do not like each other.

“他问你们，这批药材是送往何处？作何用途？你们是接了荆湖转运的调令吗？”汉人将军侧过头看了那蒙古将军一眼，压低声音：“这鞑子怕是知道你们是巨富，不让你们脱一层皮估计是讨不了好的。有什么值钱的玩意都先呈上来，向大汗和元帅表表心意……”

"He asks where this medicine is going and what for. Are you under orders from the Jinghu transport office?" The Chinese general glances at the Mongol and lowers his voice. "This Tartar knows your house is rich. He won't let you go without skinning you. Whatever you have of value, offer it up now, as a gift to the Khan and the Marshal..."

无论答应与否，父亲都独自上前交涉，让HO2去队尾与伙计清点。伙计劝HO2偷偷离开。队首传来嘈杂声：交涉失败，父亲身首分离。▶ 此时播放音效「斩 Slash」（播放列表 → 音效 Sound effects）。

Whatever you answer, your father goes forward alone and sends you to the rear to count stock with the clerks. The clerks beg you to slip away. Then noise from the front: the talk has failed, and your father is beheaded. ▶ Play the 斩 Slash sound effect here (Playlists → 音效 Sound effects).

一蓬血雾扬起，紧接着是一颗随着刀刃的势头斜飞而出的头颅——你爹头一次飞这么高，掉落在地上又那般重。马蹄和车辙相继碾过去，这一滩血迹消失得无影无踪。

A mist of blood, then a head flung sideways by the stroke of the blade. Your father never flew so high, and never fell so heavily. Hooves and cart-wheels roll over the spot until the stain is gone.

主持人：地图上的“药车”是标记。音效响起时右键“药车·残骸”→切换可见，再隐藏“药车”。

GM: the medicine cart on the map is a token: as the Slash plays, right-click "The medicine cart, wrecked" → toggle visibility, then hide "The medicine cart".

HO2只能逃入樊城：敏捷检定判断是否受伤，失败扣1D3且本模组内无法痊愈，生命值上限-1。

You run for Fencewall. DEX roll: on a failure take 1D3, a wound that will not fully heal in this scenario, and max HP -1.

城门戒严：守门的是宋兵，吊桥半起，城头弓弩对着城外。信誉/交涉说服卫兵放行。若表明是药行少东家领朝廷指令而来，巡视城门的牛富会上前交谈；即使不说，HO2也能注意到这位身背漆黑强弓的将军。牛富可告知樊城近况与范天顺在城中捉贼的消息，并答应HO2提出的任何合理请求。

The gate is under martial law: Song soldiers hold it, the drawbridge is half up, crossbows on the wall point outward. Credit Rating or Persuade to get in. If you say you are the pharmacy heir on court business, Niu the Archer, inspecting the gate, comes to talk; even if not, you notice the general with the black bow on his back. He tells you the news (Commander Fan is hunting a thief in town) and promises to help with anything you ask.

牛富（读给玩家）：城头走下来一个人。四十来岁，黝黑精瘦，披一身旧铁甲，背上斜挂一把漆黑的长弓，比常人的弓长出一截，弓背上缠着磨白的皮条。目光如炬：先看你的手，再看你的车，最后才看你的脸。守门兵见了他都往后让半步。他只报了名号：牛富，樊城钤辖，范将军麾下掌兵。

Niu the Archer (read aloud): A man comes down from the wall. Forties, dark-skinned, lean and hard as a drawn bowstring, in old iron armour. Slung across his back is a long black bow, a hand longer than any you have seen, its grip wrapped in leather worn pale. Eyes like torches: he looks at your hands first, then at your carts, and only then at your face. The gate guards step back half a pace as he passes. He gives only his name and office: Niu, garrison commander of Fencewall, under Commander Fan.

（牛富是樊城钤辖，范天顺之下掌兵马。两军对阵前他一箭射死了阿术的侄子，蒙古人记着这笔账。他对HO2直率、客气，说到做到——只要他还自由。）

(Niu is the garrison commander under Commander Fan. Before the armies met he shot Ashu's nephew dead with a single arrow; the Mongols have not forgotten. With HO2 he is blunt, courteous, and keeps his word, for as long as he is free.)

（这副可射四百步的神臂弓，不久后牛富入狱时会交到打更少年方未名手里。）

(That bow shoots four hundred paces. When Niu is thrown in the gaol it will pass to Nameless Fang, the watchman boy.)

住客栈或被百姓收留可听到街头琐碎情报：穷凶极恶的疤脸女亡命徒（秋筠）、寺庙的醉和尚、神出鬼没的打更人。

At an inn or a townsman's house you pick up gossip: a scarred woman outlaw (Autumn), a drunk monk at the temple, a night watchman who is everywhere.

数日后（叙述）：没安歇几天，元军总攻。一月三日，守将范天顺不肯降，在衙署自缢殉国；次日他的侄子范玉楼开城献降，以保全城中几万百姓。阿术下令不得劫掠，街上却到处是蒙古巡逻兵。牛富拒降，被下了大狱——他答应你的事，也就随他的自由一起没了。父亲身死的消息不知有没有传到江对岸，你家在临安府的偌大产业如今群龙无首：你必须回去。

Days later (narrate): You have barely rested when the assault comes. On 3 January Commander Fan 范天顺 refuses to surrender and hangs himself in the Magistracy; the next day his nephew, Magistrate Fan 范玉楼, opens the gates to spare the tens of thousands inside. Marshal Ashu forbids looting, but Mongol patrols now walk every street. Niu refused to surrender and is in the gaol; his promises to you died with his freedom. Nobody knows if word of your father's death has reached the far bank, and your family's great house in the capital, Lin'an 临安, is leaderless. You have to get home.

可汉江上连通襄樊的浮桥已被截断，江岸日夜有兵把守，城里的人很难和对岸通上消息。好在只要钱到位，总有人愿意铤而走险。你四处打听，入夜后带着全副身家，来到江岸边一处不引人注目的芦苇丛——别的想过河的人，也都聚在了那里。→ 公共导入。

But the floating bridge between the two cities has been cut, soldiers watch the bank day and night, and no one in town can get word across. Still, where there is money there is someone willing to risk it. You ask around, and after dark you come, with everything you own, to an unremarkable clump of reeds on the riverbank, where the other people who mean to cross tonight have gathered too. → Night Crossing.

个人导入 HO3：衙署逃脱（场景：樊城衙署） · Personal intro HO3: escape from the Magistracy (scene: Fencewall Magistracy)

朝廷命你为宣抚使发兵救援襄樊。刘卿堂请缨，率五千人随行。蒙古人以樊城为饵伏击，你们几乎毫无还手之力，幸得刘卿堂指挥，余八百人突入樊城。

The court names you Commissioner and sends you to relieve the twin cities. Captain Liu volunteers and brings five thousand men. The Mongols ambush you outside Fencewall; only Liu's handling saves eight hundred, who break into the city.

衙署夜宴（读给玩家）：范天顺在衙署大堂设宴接你——朝廷的宣抚使到了，不能不接；可满桌没有一个人有心思吃。蒙古人离城只有一天的路。陪坐的有他的侄子范玉楼，一脸笑；他的女儿范玉莹，一言不发；还有通判许德显，一个肥胖松软的人，满脸油光，替所有人吃喝。坐在你对面的是樊城钤辖牛富：黝黑精瘦，紧得像一张拉满的弓，目光如炬，酒菜不动，眼睛盯着门。举杯敬皇上，敬大捷；第二杯没人信。

Dinner at the Magistracy (read aloud): Commander Fan 范天顺 receives you with a banquet in the Magistracy hall, because that is what one does for an imperial Commissioner, and nobody at the table has the heart for it. The Mongols are a day's march away. At the Commander's side sit his nephew, Magistrate Fan 范玉楼, all smiles; his daughter, Lady Fan 范玉莹, who says nothing; and Prefect Xu 许德显, a soft, heavy man whose face shines with sweat and lamp oil and who eats and drinks for everyone. Across from you is the garrison commander, Niu 牛富: dark, lean, hard as a drawn bowstring, with eyes like torches; he touches neither wine nor food and watches the door. Toasts are drunk to the Emperor and to victory. No one believes the second.

宴罢，范玉楼亲自提灯送你去住所，一路夸赞：你的家世、你的学问、樊城何其有幸。夸赞之间，他像是故意要你留意似的，说起几句闲话：今年冬天真暖和；汉江的水，这个时节怎么这么大；怪事。

Afterwards Magistrate Fan himself walks you to your lodging, lantern in hand, flattering you all the way: your family, your learning, how lucky Fencewall is to have you. Between the compliments he drops odd remarks, as if he wanted you to notice them: how warm this winter has been; how high the Han is running for the season; how strange that is.

（范玉楼的闲话是河神线的伏笔，不要解释。牛富、许德显的样子让玩家记住：牛富之后守北门、入狱；许德显的两封信是弄到船的筹码。）

(Magistrate Fan's remarks are the book's plant for the River God; don't explain them. The portraits of Niu and Xu are for later: Niu will hold the North Gate and end in the gaol; Xu's two letters are the lever for the boats.)

未几蒙古全面攻城。范天顺请你与刘卿堂带余兵先往襄阳。出发定在中午；你因伤未愈留下休息。刚过午后，衙署外骚乱，晴天骤然阴沉如夜却无雨。仆役四散，蒙古骑兵闯入官邸抄家捉人。

Then the full assault. Commander Fan orders you and Liu across to Southbright at noon; your wound keeps you in bed. Just past noon: uproar outside, the clear sky goes dark as night without a drop of rain, servants scatter, and Mongol cavalry ride into the compound seizing people.

检定：用合理方式潜行/困难幸运离开衙署；失败则接受蒙古士兵不讲道理的盘问，任何可疑之处都会被抓。强行逃离也可以，失败可能添新伤。

Roll: Stealth, or Hard Luck, to get out with some plausible plan; fail and you face soldiers who arrest anyone suspicious. Fighting your way out is allowed; a failure means another wound.

之后HO3在城中暂时落脚。浮桥已断，江岸有兵，你必须马上到对岸与同袍汇合。好在只要钱到位……→ 公共导入。

You hide in the town. The bridge is gone, the bank guarded; you must cross and rejoin your men. Money finds a boatman... → Night Crossing.

公共导入：夜渡汉水（场景：汉江夜渡） · Shared intro: Night Crossing (scene: Night Crossing of the Han River)

一二六八年一月十一日子时。无星无月，浓雾遮天，远处只有近岸几点灯火——蒙古军日夜驻守。襄樊间河段宽四百五十丈，今夜能见度约十米。你们陆续来到樊城东的芦苇荡，守军三个时辰换岗，此刻正交接。芦苇一人多高，足以藏船。船夫来得稍迟；等候的有三人——今夜的旅客不止一位。

Midnight, 11 January 1268. No stars, no moon, fog over everything; only a few watch-fires on the bank, where the Mongols keep guard day and night. The river is 1.5 km wide; tonight you can see ten metres. You arrive one by one at the Reed Marsh east of Fencewall. The guards change every six hours, and this is the change. The reeds stand taller than a man. The boatman is late; three of you are waiting. You are not the only passenger tonight.

  • 侦查：离岸不远有几只小船，均未点灯，行得极慢——其他趁夜渡河的人。
    Spot Hidden: several small boats offshore, unlit, barely moving: other night-crossers.
  • 灵感：寒冬深夜，不是起雾的天气。
    Idea: midwinter, midnight; this is not fog weather.

船夫姓王，粗麻布衣，斗笠，只剩一条手臂，腰缠脏毛巾。他看得出你们不是本地人，看得出HO3气度不凡。他痛骂蒙古人暴虐，抱怨朝廷不作为。可问出：

The boatman is called Wang: coarse hemp, a straw hat, one arm, a filthy towel at his belt. He can tell you are not local and that HO3 is somebody. He curses the Mongols and the court. He will tell you:

  • 断臂：世代打渔，被征作民夫搬运粮草时被马车压断。
    The arm: fisherman for generations; crushed by an army cart when he was pressed as a porter.
  • 范天顺：勤政爱民，治军严苛，能为卒吮脓；朝廷却尽派小娃娃领兵，害他自缢。
    Commander Fan: a man who would suck the pus from a soldier's wound; the court sent him children to command, and he hanged himself for it.
  • 江上异象：汉水女神显灵，她温和自持，必会怜悯将士魂灵。
    The fog: the Lady of the Han, who is gentle and modest and surely pities the drowned soldiers.
  • 刺杀阿术：他主动提起，游侠的美名传遍全城，只是生死不明。
    The assassination: he brings it up himself; the whole town praises the nameless wanderer, nobody knows if he lives.

主持人：场景上的船是标记。划船时拖动“船夫王的渡船”出芦苇；脊刺攻击时显示“渔船残骸”与脊刺、隐藏“前方渔船”；中箭沉船时显示“渡船·沉没”、隐藏渡船（右键标记→切换可见）。

GM: the boats on the map are tokens. Drag Wang's ferry out of the reeds as they row; at the spine attack reveal "The fishing boat, wrecked" and the spine and hide "The fishing boat ahead"; when the arrows sink them reveal "Wang's ferry, sinking" and hide the ferry (right-click a token → toggle visibility).

轻舟一叶，飘若浮萍。不敢点灯，行得极慢。离岸几十米，前方十米内有另一艘小渔船轮廓若隐若现（夜色漆黑，侦查-20）。

A single light boat, drifting like a leaf. No lamp, dead slow. A few dozen metres out, the shape of another fishing boat shows ten metres ahead (Spot Hidden at -20 in the dark).

  • 聆听：前方木板折断的刺耳声，几声惊恐呼喊。
    Listen: the shriek of splitting planks ahead, then screams.
  • 侦查：渔船剧烈晃动，闪动的人影皆持兵器。
    Spot Hidden: the boat rocks violently; the figures on it hold weapons.

无论是否接近，那船上的人匆忙点灯。借那一点亮光，你们看见船体被一条巨大脊刺摧毁（理智 0/1）：

Whether or not you close in, they light a lamp. By that scrap of light you see the boat destroyed by an enormous spine (SAN 0/1):

那艘渔船力胜不过二十石，被那样一条巨大触足横穿而过，几乎生生折断。触足末端卷曲，肥大柔软，表皮却极其坚硬，倒刺遍布，反射着凛凛寒光。浓雾中灯火照得人影绰绰，有人拿出武器，有人落水。那条触足只是沉默地将船舱挤压成碎片，船上的人没来得及求救就彻底没了声。

A boat that could carry twenty bushels, run clean through and nearly snapped by a tentacle-like spine. Its tip curls, fat and soft, but the hide is hard as iron and bristling with barbs that catch the light. In the lamp-glow figures lurch, some drawing weapons, some going into the water. The spine simply, silently crushes the hull to splinters. Nobody has time to call for help before the sound stops.

岸上蒙古士兵发现动静，弓箭手射来，小船终将中箭沉没。▶ 播放音效「箭 Arrows」。闪避决定是否中箭（1D3）；游泳决定沉船后剩下多少随身物品（失败只剩调查员指定的三件）；体质决定是否被冰冷江水伤害（失败扣1D3）。

The watch on the bank hears. Archers shoot; your boat will sink. ▶ Play the 箭 Arrows sound effect. Dodge or take an arrow (1D3). Swim: on a failure you keep only three named possessions. CON: on a failure the freezing water costs 1D3 HP.

船夫丢下你们独自逃走。岸边两男一女游来救人。时间紧迫，他们暂不报名号，只说是城中游侠义勇，受越南柯越大夫所托守在岸边相助。随后沿小路带你们到前街一处小宅院：前半是店铺，已打烊。

The boatman abandons you. From the bank two men and a woman swim out and drag you ashore. No time for names: they are townsmen, knights-errant, sent by Doctor Yue to wait for you. They lead you by back lanes to a small house on Front Street, shop in front, closed for the night.

长相相似的两名男子是同卵兄弟姜楼与姜阁；高大健硕的女子曲流是店主。姜楼跳脱，姜阁沉稳，曲流严肃而细致体贴。炉火生起后才是聊天的时候：

The two look-alikes are the twins Tower and Loft Jiang; the big, powerfully built woman is Winding Stream, who owns the shop. Tower is restless, Loft steady, Winding Stream stern but attentive. Once the stove is lit, they talk:

  • 越南柯：行走江湖，劫富济贫，来樊城不久却极受百姓爱戴。平日在前街问诊。他算出你们命中有此劫，特叫他们来相助。
    Doctor Yue: a wandering healer who robs the rich for the poor; new in town but adored. He sees patients on Front Street. He "calculated" that you would meet disaster tonight and sent them.
  • 渡河：如今没人接这活了，得自己筹谋：船要坚固快速，船夫要熟水性。
    Crossing: nobody will take the job now; you will have to arrange it yourselves: a strong fast boat and a boatman who knows the water.
  • 船与船夫：游侠中有水性极好的人，老渔夫也有经验，但钱未必打动人心。城内船只已被蒙古人征用；世家大族或官员或有藏私。
    Boat and boatman: some of the wanderers swim like fish, and the old fishermen know the river, but money may not be enough now. The Mongols have seized every boat in town; a great family or an official may have one hidden.
  • 脊刺：曲流讶异，认为是荆楚巫师做法。姜阁：“蒙古人若要攻襄阳，非走水路不可。若汉水里盘踞着此物，蒙古人难道还能渡过去么？”
    The spine: Winding Stream is shocked and blames the shamans of the old Chu lands. Loft: "If the Mongols want Southbright they must cross by water. With that thing in the river, can they?"

夜深了。曲流递给HO2一个越南柯留下的油纸包：几块酥糖，花生瓜子，色泽鲜艳，香气扑鼻。品尝就会发现其实是伪装成酥糖的生姜。

It is late. Winding Stream hands HO2 an oil-paper packet left by Doctor Yue: a few pieces of nut brittle, glossy and fragrant. Taste one: it is raw ginger disguised as candy.

在此停下。下次聚会：公布樊城地图，进入自由调查轮（每日早中晚三轮）。

Stop here. Next session: reveal the Fencewall map and begin the free investigation rounds (three a day).

名词注释 · Terms

  • 沿街浮屋：百姓自支的小摊。分茶：大食楼。会馆：外商歇脚的宾馆，现为蒙古人占用。瓦子：表演娱乐场所。
    Street stalls; a 分茶 is a big restaurant; the Merchants' Hall is an inn now used by the Mongols; a 瓦子 is a playhouse.

pages.name: 加时：第一日 Extended: Day One

text.content:
加时：第一日（一月十二日） · Extended session 0: Day One (12 January)

若时间充裕，姜汁酥糖之后不要停，继续到十三日拂晓。约再加一到一个半小时。只用一张新地图（街口）；其余回到棺材铺与汉江岸。

If you have time after the ginger candy, keep going to dawn on the 13th: about 60–90 more minutes, one new map (the Street Crossing), the rest back at the Coffin Shop and the riverbank.

向玩家公布：行动轮 · Tell the players: action rounds 行动轮

从明天起，每天分早、午、晚三轮。去一个地点、做一件事，消耗一轮。吃饭、回棺材铺、去酒肆不消耗。今晚先睡。

From tomorrow the day has three rounds: morning, noon, evening. Going to a place and doing one thing there costs a round. Eating, going home to the Coffin Shop and the Wineshop are free. Tonight you sleep.

前街到处是元军巡逻和HO1的通缉令（段游衍画像时故意画得模糊，只说个轮廓）。HO1若乔装失败，以队伍中最低的幸运检定是否被认出；再失败则敏捷逃脱，且本轮去不了目的地。

Front Street is full of patrols and wanted posters for HO1 (Duan 段游衍 drew the face deliberately vague: give a silhouette, no more). If HO1 fails Disguise, the lowest Luck in the party decides whether a soldier recognises him; fail that and it is a DEX roll to get away and the round is lost.

十一日夜：第一次梦引（仅HO3） · Night of the 11th: the first Dream-Call 梦引 (HO3 only)

HO3梦中似有熟悉的声音呼唤其名，诱其赴约。检定意志；失败则听见波涛翻涌、船只折断、人们凄厉惨叫，理智损失1/1D3。

As HO3 falls asleep a familiar voice calls their name, inviting them somewhere. Roll POW. On a failure they hear waves heaving, timbers snapping and people screaming: SAN 1/1D3. Do this quietly with the HO3 player; the others only see them wake badly.

十二日早：棺材铺白天（场景：棺材铺） · Morning of the 12th: the Coffin Shop by day (scene: the Coffin Shop)

粟米粥、白面饼子、咸菜。铺面不大，殡葬用品堆得拥挤；几台完工的棺材掀着盖晾漆。侦查：棺材内壁有放置物品的暗格。

Millet porridge, flatbread, pickles. The shopfront is small and crammed with funeral goods; a few finished coffins stand open to dry their lacquer. Spot Hidden: the inner walls have hidden compartments for grave goods.

  • 棺材：战时死人多，家家用得上。她手艺高，范天顺的棺材也是她做的。
    Coffins: in wartime every family needs one. She is good; she made Commander Fan's 范天顺 coffin too.
  • 暗格：有人把死者随身物放进暗格，防偷防腐；范玉楼也提过同样的要求。
    Compartments: people put the dead's belongings inside against thieves and rot. Magistrate Fan 范玉楼 asked for one as well.

然后让他们商量今天去哪里：主持人只需简述四区——前街（商铺、药行分号、瓦子）、后街（会馆、寺庙）、衙署一带、江岸（码头、芦苇荡）。本加时只跑午时街口；其余留给第一次正式聚会。

Then let them plan the day. You only need to name the four districts: Front Street (shops, HO2's pharmacy branch, the playhouse), Back Street (the Merchants' Hall where Duan lives, the temple), the Magistracy quarter, the riverbank (docks, reed marsh). This extension only plays the noon event at the Street Crossing; whatever else they choose, say "you spend the morning on it; we pick it up next time" and move to noon.

十二日午：街口固定事件（场景：街口） · Noon of the 12th: the Street Crossing 街口 (scene: the Street Crossing)

前街后街的交汇口，必经之地。行脚店、茶摊；死刑犯在此弃市，午时三刻问斩，尸体挂到子时。

The junction of Front and Back Street; everyone passes here. An inn, a tea stall; this is where the condemned are executed, at a quarter past noon, and left hanging until midnight.

午时，街口人头攒动，气氛诡谲凝重。今日弃市的是个白发老叟，缺一条手臂，枪尖自喉咙穿过，挑起身体悬于半空。HO1认出是恩师山阳道人。他面容安详，似早料到有此劫。若师父对HO1重要：理智1/1D3。

At noon the crossing is packed and the mood is strange and heavy. Today's dead man is a white-haired old man with one arm missing, a spear through his throat, hoisted so the body hangs in the air. HO1 recognises their master, the Hermit of Mount Crag 山阳道人. His face is calm, as if he had expected this. If the master mattered to HO1: SAN 1/1D3. Let the HO1 player react; do not rush it.

路人：

From the crowd:

  • 兀良哈为报徒弟一剑之仇，上岘首山抓走年逾七十的山阳道人，也还他一刀。止水不过三尺，阿术一把斩马刀却能将人拦腰砍断。
    "Ashu went up Mount Crag himself to pay the old man back for his pupil's cut. Seventy years old. That little sword of his, Stillwater, is three feet long; the Marshal's horse-cutter took a man in half at the waist."
  • 阿术要斩不肯投降的宋臣，包括还关在监牢里的牛富等人。幸亏小范大人投降得快，殃及不到咱们平头百姓。
    "The Marshal is going to execute every Song officer who won't surrender, Niu the Archer 牛富 in the gaol among them. Thank heaven the young Magistrate gave in fast, or it'd be us."

主持人注意：牛富将在十五日午时在此处斩首，押送队伍可被劫（原书p29的规则）。这是第一次正式聚会的大场面；今天只埋下这句话。

GM note: Niu is to be beheaded here at noon on the 15th and the convoy can be ambushed (rules on p29 of the original). That is the set-piece of the next session; today you only plant the line.

十二日晚：越南柯来访（场景：棺材铺） · Evening of the 12th: Doctor Yue 越南柯 calls (scene: the Coffin Shop)

回到棺材铺，一位江湖郎中打扮的人正和曲流攀谈：HO2的师兄“空空郎中”越南柯。他关心众人、尤其HO2的身体。

Back at the shop a man dressed as a wandering healer is chatting with Winding Stream: HO2's foster brother, Doctor Yue 越南柯, the Hollow Physician. He fusses over everyone's health, HO2's most. Play the reunion; HO2 has not seen him in years.

  • 船只：两封未寄出的信，都是荆湖通判许德显写的。一封给蒙古军营，表投诚之心，说家里还有三艘画舫、五艘小船愿双手奉上；一封给襄阳吕文焕，字字泣血表忠心。越南柯借看诊之名偷来，可用来胁迫许德显。
    Boats: two unsent letters, both by Prefect Xu 许德显. One to the Mongol camp offering to surrender and hand over his three pleasure-barges and five small boats; one to Governor Lü 吕文焕 in Southbright, weeping loyalty to the Song. Yue stole them during a 'consultation'. Either letter would ruin Xu; together they are a lever to get his boats.
  • 解毒：他懂得不多，但若是本地传说中的毒，地方图志上没准有记述。
    The poison (Rainmaster's Ink 雨师墨, if HO1 asks): he knows little, but if it is a local legend the county gazetteer 地方志 may record it. (Library 官学&书阁, next session.)
  • 疤脸女子：满脸疤痕，要么遭了不测，要么是该处死刑的囚犯。
    The scar-faced woman the town gossips about: a face like that means either a disaster or a condemned criminal.
  • 范天顺：高瞻远瞩，对百姓尽心尽力，连偷几两灯油的人都要处以极刑。
    Commander Fan: far-sighted, devoted to the people; had a man executed for stealing a few ounces of lamp oil. (Said flat. Let them wonder.)

十二日夜：第二次梦引（场景：汉江夜渡，调暗） · Night of the 12th: the second Dream-Call (scene: Night Crossing, darkness up)

格拉基再次梦引HO3，驱其独自前往江岸，并以光亮幻象引诱。梦中：

Gla'aki 格拉基 calls HO3 again, drawing them alone to the riverbank with a lure of light. The dream (read aloud to HO3, SAN 1/1D3):

你站在船头，脚下的水面波涛不宁。雾气升腾遮天蔽日，连对岸的城市都没了踪影。水下黑色的团状物紧随而来，攀住船身，折断船舷和龙骨，击穿甲板。你在风雨中坠落，直到有什么东西自你脊椎后方穿胸而过。你低下头，伤口正滋滋往外冒着绿色的腐烂液体……

"You stand at the bow. The water under you heaves. Fog rises until it hides the sky and the city on the far bank. Something black and shapeless comes up under the boat, clings to it, snaps the gunwale and the keel, punches through the deck. You fall through wind and rain, until something comes through your spine from behind and out of your chest. You look down. The wound is hissing, and what runs out of it is green and rotten..."

再检定意志：成功，睁眼发现自己在江岸边；失败，已走进汉江，水没过腰。江面寂静，雾气混沌，前方似有发光物闪烁；跟着走几步，水到胸口。闪光物一晃钻入水底，从后方刺向脊背：闪避成功躲开，失败受1D3擦伤。

POW again. Success: HO3 opens their eyes standing at the water's edge. Failure: they are already in the Han, waist deep. The river is silent, the fog thick, a glow flickers ahead; a few steps after it and the water is at their chest. The glow dips under and strikes from behind at the spine: Dodge, or 1D3 scratch.

刺来的是一根漆黑脊刺，布满鳞甲倒刺，末端纤细尖锐，与昨夜所见相同。此时刘卿堂出现在岸边，扔给HO3一把锈剑，进入战斗轮（▶ 播放音效「战 Battle」）。脊刺：HP 10，敏捷50，斗殴40，伤害2+1D5。击败即脱险。

It is a black spine, scaled and barbed, thin and sharp at the tip, the same as last night. And on the bank stands Captain Liu 刘卿堂, who throws HO3 a rusty sword. Combat (▶ play the 战 Battle sound effect): the spine has HP 10, DEX 50, Fighting 40, damage 2+1D5, armour 4. Beat it (or drive it off) and the danger ends. If HO3 is alone and losing, Liu takes the hits; he does not die tonight.

Who's who 人物

Players' lines in plain text; the GM-only truth in red.

The three of you · 你们

Lu Bluecliff 陆青崖
HO1 The Wanderer 游侠
24. A wandering swordsman from Mount Crag 岘山; plain clothes, a sabre at his hip and a wrapped sword on his back he never shows. Says little, misses nothing.
GM: Tried to kill Ashu at the banquet with the poisoned sword Stillwater 止水; only cut his shoulder (Ashu now has a penalty die on everything). Duan Driftwood is his old classmate and covered his escape. His master wants Ashu's head.
Shen Pearl 沈怀珠
HO2 The Merchant Heir 商贾
20. Heir to a great pharmacy house of the capital; silk under a plain coat, soft hands, a medicine chest. Clever, quick-tongued, used to money solving things.
GM: Her father was beheaded by Toghan's detachment outside the North Gate. Her foster brother is Doctor Yue 越南柯 (fraud, thief, the man who wrecked Fan's rite). Family art: Acupoint Strike 点穴.
Xie Cloudmane 谢云骧
HO3 The Commissioner 命官
22. Youngest son of a great family and the court's Commissioner, seal and all. Handsome, educated, raised to be obeyed; the best archer at the table; carries a wound that will not close.
GM: His army was destroyed; his oldest friend Captain Liu 刘卿堂 led the last 800 across the river on 3 January and was caught in Fan's rite. Gla'aki calls him in dreams (first Dream-Call on the night of the 11th).

The Mongols · 蒙古

Marshal Ashu 阿术
Mongol commander-in-chief
Of the Uriankhai; Kublai's right arm. A brilliant general and a terrifying fighter: well over six feet, bearded, a huge sabre. Took Fencewall in three days; forbids looting. Wounded in the shoulder at his own victory feast.
GM: Rainmaster's Ink: the wound never heals; every roll with a penalty die for the rest of the scenario. Will have Niu beheaded at the Street Crossing on the 15th. Killing him triggers the city lockdown in the finale.
Duan Driftwood 段游衍
Song general turned Mongol
From the Dali 大理 clan. Surrendered to the Song, then to the Mongols; sits one seat down from Ashu and does his talking in Chinese. Smooth, pleasant, and the man every scholar loves to curse.
GM: Cowardly, loyal to no dynasty, but admires HO1 (studied a year under the same master) and has promised the Hermit to protect him. Made chaos at the banquet so HO1 could escape.
General Toghan 脱欢
Mongol general
One of Ashu's generals. Barely speaks Chinese; hard and greedy. Commands the detachments on the roads around the city.
GM: His detachment stopped the medicine convoy and beheaded HO2's father.
Mongol soldiers 蒙古兵
Patrols and guards
Foot and horse. Everywhere in town after dark; they carry weapons, tokens, money and written orders.
GM: Armour 2. Sleight of Hand to lift tokens or papers.

The Song · 宋

Commander Fan 范天顺
Late commander of Fencewall
Beloved, hard-working, harsh with wrongdoers. Refused to surrender and hanged himself in the Magistracy on the night of 3 January.
GM: Bought the Grand Lake Stone with Gla'aki's shard in 1266; summoned the thing in the river with condemned prisoners as sacrifices to stop a Mongol crossing. It fired early and destroyed Liu's flotilla. Asked Winding Stream for a coffin with a hidden compartment.
Magistrate Fan 范玉楼
Fan's nephew; runs the town for the Mongols
Opened the gates the morning after his uncle's death to spare the people. Now flatters Ashu at banquets. Embarrassing to watch; perhaps not a coward.
GM: Knows more of his uncle's plan than he says. The Library holds the county gazetteer with the poison.
Niu the Archer 牛富
Garrison commander, in the gaol
Forties, dark, lean as a bowstring, eyes like torches. His God-Arm Bow 神臂弓 shoots four hundred paces; before the siege he shot Ashu's nephew dead. Refused to surrender; the Mongols cut his hand-tendons and locked him up.
GM: To be beheaded at noon on the 15th. His bow passes to Nameless Fang, the watchman boy: a finale prerequisite.
Prefect Xu 许德显
The region's prefect
A senior Song official who stayed on and now dines at Ashu's table. His family owns boats.
GM: Two letters exist: one offering his boats to the Mongols, one swearing loyalty to the Song. Doctor Yue has stolen them: blackmail lever for the boats.
Captain Liu 刘卿堂
HO3's oldest friend
Hot-blooded, generous, a jianghu air about him. Led HO3's last eight hundred men across the river on 3 January. Not seen since.
GM: The flotilla was destroyed by Gla'aki. Liu came out of the water undying but with his own mind: no pulse, immune to poison and disease, a red web-mark on his back. The Servants attack him first. Joins the party on the night of the 12th.

People of Fencewall · 樊城人

Winding Stream 曲流
Owner of the coffin shop by the river
About fifty, tall and heavily built, an ex-caravan guard with a big blade on her back. Gentle with guests; makes the best coffins in town. Your shelter after the crossing.
GM: Killed her cheating husband with one cut ten years ago. Built Commander Fan's coffin, with a hidden compartment: a planted clue.
Boatman Wang 船夫王
The one-armed boatman
Curses the Mongols and the court in the same breath. For a price he will row you across tonight.
GM: Abandons the passengers when the boat sinks.
The Jiang twins 姜楼、姜阁
Fishermen brothers
Strong swimmers who know every reed-bed. Jiang Tower is the steady elder, Jiang Loft the reckless younger.
GM: They pull the investigators out of the river and lead them to Winding Stream.
Doctor Yue 越南柯
A wandering healer
Handsome, charming, hands like a conjurer's; turns up where he is least expected and gives money to the poor.
GM: HO2's foster brother. Cannot fight and cannot heal: fakes medicine and steals. Blundered into Fan's rite; carries Prefect Xu's letters. Calls at the coffin shop on the evening of the 12th.
Autumn 秋筠
A scar-faced woman outlaw
Town gossip: hides somewhere in the back streets, hunted by both sides.
GM: Helps the investigators later in the sandbox; her help costs no action round.
The drowned 溺者
What the fog brings
Boats go out and do not come back. Some townsfolk are found at the bank at dawn, soaked, remembering nothing.
GM: Undying Servants: Liu's drowned men, puppets of Gla'aki, moving by night and luring people to the water. Hit on the injection scar on the spine kills outright.

pages.name: 故事全貌 The whole story & timeline

text.content:
主持人：故事全貌与时间线 · GM: The whole story, and the timeline

What Commander Fan did. In 1266 Commander Fan 范天顺 bought an ornamental Grand Lake Stone 太湖石 with eighty-one holes. The green jade set in hole 46 is a shard of Gla'aki 格拉基, the "Many-Headed Fish" of old travel books: a thing that calls people into water in their dreams and makes the drowned walk again. Fan, dutiful and clear-eyed, knew Fencewall could not hold, and kept the stone as a last weapon: wake the thing in the river and no army could cross.

The night of 3 January. As the Mongol assault began, Fan took condemned prisoners to the bank as sacrifices and began the rite. Doctor Yue 越南柯, hiding nearby, blundered into it, and it fired early: into the river just as Captain Liu 刘卿堂's flotilla, HO3's last eight hundred men ordered across to Southbright, was in midstream. The boats were smashed. The men drowned. Some climbed back out with a red web-mark on their backs and no pulse: Undying Servants 不死仆从, puppets of the thing in the river. Liu alone came out with his own mind. Fan, seeing what he had done, hanged himself that night; his nephew Magistrate Fan 范玉楼 opened the gates in the morning.

Now. The fog is Gla'aki's. The Mongols cannot cross (their assault on Southbright slips from the 9th to the 18th). The Servants move through the town by night and lure people to the bank; the thing calls in dreams, HO3 first (POW each night). Niu the Archer 牛富 waits in the gaol for his beheading at noon on the 15th. Prefect Xu 许德显 has boats and two incriminating letters. Ashu 阿术 nurses a shoulder wound from Stillwater 止水 that will never heal.

Session 0 is the three personal intros and the Night Crossing: the boat is wrecked by a spine from the river, the Jiang twins pull the party out, and they wake in Winding Stream 曲流's coffin shop. Day One (12 Jan) adds the Street Crossing, Doctor Yue's visit with Xu's letters, and Liu joining the party. The sandbox (12–15 Jan, three action rounds a day) is about the gaol, Xu's boats, the gazetteer's poison and the Ling needles. The finale is at the Watchtower 塔楼: with Niu's God-Arm Bow 神臂弓, the needles and a fire signal the investigators can end what Fan started, and decide whether Ashu lives.

伤势与治疗 · Wounds & Healing

克苏鲁的呼唤第七版的受伤与恢复规则，供主持人查阅。沈怀珠的医学为65（困难32，极难13）。

Call of Cthulhu 7e damage and recovery rules for the Keeper's reference. Shen Pearl's Medicine is 65 (Hard 32, Extreme 13).

受伤 · Taking damage

  • 普通伤害直接扣除生命值。
    Ordinary hits just subtract HP.
  • 重伤：单次伤害达到最大生命值的一半或以上（沈怀珠11点，故6点即算）→ 倒地，掷体质，失败则昏迷。
    Major Wound: one hit for half or more of max HP (Shen Pearl has 11, so 6+) → falls prone; CON roll or faints.
  • 生命值归零、没有重伤 → 昏迷，稍后自行醒来。
    0 HP without a Major Wound → unconscious, wakes later.
  • 生命值归零、且有重伤 → 濒死：下一轮结束时死亡，除非有人急救成功；之后每小时掷体质直到医学成功为止。
    0 HP with a Major Wound → dying: dead at the end of the next round unless someone passes First Aid; then a CON roll every hour until Medicine succeeds.

急救 First Aid（陆青崖50，沈怀珠50） · First Aid (Lu Bluecliff 50, Shen Pearl 50)

  • 每处伤只能试一次，须在受伤后约一小时内。约一分钟。
    One attempt per injury, within about an hour of it. Takes about a minute.
  • 成功 → 恢复1点生命值；对濒死者则是稳住伤势（不加生命值）。
    Success → +1 HP; on a dying character it stabilises them (no HP).

医学 Medicine（沈怀珠65） · Medicine (Shen Pearl 65)

  • 每处伤只能试一次，需要一小时和药具（她的药箱即可）。
    One attempt per injury; needs an hour of work and kit (her medicine chest counts).
  • 成功 → 恢复1D3点生命值。可在急救之后对同一处伤再施医学，两者都算。
    Success → +1D3 HP. May follow First Aid on the same wound; both apply.
  • 也可代替急救救治濒死者。
    Can also be used instead of First Aid to stop someone dying.
  • 大失败 → 伤势恶化（主持人裁定：失去急救的那1点、病人加重）。同一处伤不可重掷；幸运点照常可用。
    Fumble → things get worse (Keeper's call: lose the First Aid point, patient worsens). No retry on the same wound; Luck points may be spent as usual.

自然恢复 · Natural healing

  • 无重伤：每天恢复1点生命值。
    No Major Wound: +1 HP per day.
  • 有重伤：每周掷一次体质，成功恢复1D3（困难成功更多；该周有医学成功则加奖励骰）。生命值回到一半以上，重伤才算痊愈。
    Major Wound: a CON roll once a week; success +1D3 HP (more on a Hard success; a Medicine success that week gives a bonus die). The Major Wound clears only once HP is back above half max.

桌上流程 · At the table

沈怀珠说「我来治」→ 掷d100小于等于65 → 主持人掷1D3 → 加上去。擦伤一两天就好；重伤（例如牛富的箭）若无人医治，一周内都危险。

Shen Pearl says "I treat him" → roll d100 under 65 → Keeper rolls 1D3 → add it. A scrape heals in a day or two; a Major Wound (e.g. Niu's arrow) stays dangerous for a week unless she is there.
